name: Jodaine Miller
bio: I started Summer Splash Pool Services because I saw too many communities struggling with green pools, unreliable techs, and services that disappeared when things got tough. I knew there was a better way. For us, it's more than clear water. It's protecting your amenity, your reputation, and keeping residents proud of where they live.

name: Rasheeda Larmond
bio: As Assistant Regional Manager at Summer Splash Pool Services, I am dedicated to supporting our team, building strong client relationships, and ensuring exceptional service. I take pride in being organized, dependable, and solutions-focused, with a commitment to creating positive experiences for both our customers and our team.

name: Aldeen Davis
bio: As Office Administrator, I keep everything behind the scenes running smoothly so our technicians can focus on your pool. I handle scheduling, service requests, and billing questions, and I make sure every call and email gets a quick, friendly answer. I love helping our clients feel taken care of from the very first conversation.
